messages:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring cold-cache tail we saw this morning. Need owners for prompt corpus, regression harness, and a simulated warm->cold load profile.

sam: Proposed owners: prompts -> @tara, harness -> @vik, load profile -> @sam. Timeline: prompts by Thu, harness Mon, load profile Wed.

tara: I'll extract ~60 incident prompts and add 8 adversarial variants (truncation + repeated tokens). Will put them under inference-evals/prompt-sets/incidents/2026-07-cache-tail.

vik: For the harness I'll add a deterministic `--kv-seed` option and output P50/P95/P99 warm vs cold diffs. Example: ```./eval_harness run --suite cache_tail --artifact gs://redwood-evals/incidents/2026-07-cache-tail --model redwood-v2```

sam: Load profile: baseline 120 qps, 5s ramp to 480 qps for 60s, then teardown. Capture token-level latencies and runtime queue depth. Will make it runnable in staging and nightly.

tara: Where do we store KV snapshots? gs://redwood-evals/incident-archives/2026-07 ok? I'll sanitize.

vik: ack. CI gating: non-blocking initially. If P95 delta >15% auto-notify oncall and create blocking label. Exemption flow: `ci_latency_exempt` + oncall ack.

ci-bot: Created tickets ENG-3250 (prompt corpus), ENG-3251 (regression harness), ENG-3252 (warm-cold profile).

sam: Quick sync after standup tomorrow 10m to align. Deliverables: PR with prompts + README, PR with harness + sample outputs, k6 profile PR.

tara: filing PR tonight with first 25 prompts.

vik: will open harness draft and include sample output JSON.

sam: thanks all — will add items to follow-up board and schedule the sync. :thumbsup:
